text: The White Tiger drives his host into the Snake River. They still believe rivers are roads. Yeon Gesomun has been waiting for a man who thinks that. Old men in the north remember another river that ate an army. The Snake is younger. It's hungrier. And it has Yeon's teeth.
Munmu names nineteen generals for it. One of them is Kim Jinju. He is True Bone, from a good family. He led men at the Yellow Mountain. He has a son in the emperor's guard.
Three of the emperor's four beasts come for the city at once. The Blue Dragon leads. The Black Tortoise and the second White Tiger ride behind him.
